evidence.quote: We report a headline accuracy of 76%. The study repeats the procedure across several random seeds and supplies every seed-level result.

review.explanation: The five seed accuracies have arithmetic mean (68+70+72+74+76)/5 = 72%, not the reported headline accuracy of 76%. Thus the headline accuracy does not equal the arithmetic mean across all reported random seeds.
